# 1. Open dataset

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(performance)
library(DHARMa)
library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(lattice)
library(broom.mixed) 
library(ggpubr)
library(lme4)
library(car)
library(MuMIn)
select <- dplyr::select

agri <- read.csv("3.practices_morphogroups/input/agro_data_per_field_and_year.csv") %>% 
  select(-X) %>% 
  mutate(id_parcelle=as.character(id_parcelle),
    id_uniq=paste(id_parcelle,year,sep="_"))

coleo <-  read.csv("3.practices_morphogroups/input/coleo_year.csv") %>% 
  select(-X) %>% 
  mutate(id_parcelle=as.character(id_parcelle),
         id_uniq=paste(id_parcelle,annee,sep="_")) 
summary(coleo)

coleo_tot <- coleo %>% 
  left_join(agri) %>% 
  relocate(id_uniq) %>% 
  select(-year)



overdisp_fun <- function(model) {
  rdf <- df.residual(model)
  rp <- residuals(model, type = "pearson")
  Pearson.chisq <- sum(rp^2)
  prat <- Pearson.chisq / rdf
  pval <- pchisq(Pearson.chisq, df = rdf, lower.tail = FALSE)
  c(chisq = Pearson.chisq, ratio = prat, rdf = rdf, p = pval)
}

```

# 2. Practices

## 2.2. Remove missing values

```{r}
coleo_agri <- coleo_tot %>% 
  select(1:29,TypeCulture,nbre_interv,CoefN,nbre_pesticides) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(nbre_pesticides),
         !is.na(nbre_interv),
         !is.na(CoefN)) %>% 
  group_by(id_parcelle) %>% 
  mutate(nbre_annee= n_distinct(annee)) %>% 
  filter(nbre_annee>7)  # 201 fields only after removing NA and fields with less than 7 years of samples

summary(coleo_agri)
coleo_agri$year_c <- as.numeric(
  scale(coleo_agri$annee, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
)


n_plots <- coleo_agri %>% 
  select(id_parcelle,TypeCulture) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate_all(factor)
summary(n_plots)
```

## 2.2. Temporal trends of practices

```{r}
prat <-  coleo_tot %>% 
  select(1:20,TypeCulture,nbre_interv,CoefN,nbre_pesticides,TypeCulture) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(nbre_pesticides),
         !is.na(nbre_interv),
         !is.na(CoefN)) %>% 
  group_by(id_parcelle) %>% 
  mutate(nbre_annee= n_distinct(annee)) %>% 
  filter(nbre_annee>7)
```

### 2.2.1. Nombre interventions

```{r}
mod_compois <- glmmTMB(
  nbre_interv ~ year_c + (1 | id_parcelle),
  family = compois(link = "log"),
  data = coleo_agri
) # modèle Conway–Maxwell–Poisson (COM-Poisson), un modèle de Poisson modifié mais qui permet de modéliser une dispersion inférieure à celle attendue sous Poisson comme c'est le cas ici

res_compois <- simulateResiduals(mod_compois)
plot(res_compois)
testDispersion(res_compois)
testZeroInflation(res_compois)

summary(mod_compois)
```

ns

```{r}
coleo_agri_v <- coleo_agri |> 
  filter(TypeCulture=="Vigne")
mod_compois_v <- glmmTMB(

   family = compois(link = "log"),
```

### 2.2.2. Fertilisation

```{r}
mod <- glmmTMB(
  CoefN ~ year_c + (1 | id_parcelle),
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  data = coleo_agri
)
res_N_gauss <- simulateResiduals(mod)
plot(res_N_gauss)

testUniformity(res_N_gauss)
testDispersion(res_N_gauss)
testOutliers(res_N_gauss, type = "bootstrap")

summary(mod)
```

### 2.2.3. Nombre pesticides

```{r}
mod_nb <- glmmTMB(
  nbre_pesticides ~ year_c + (1 | id_parcelle),
  family = nbinom1,
  data = coleo_agri
)

sim_res <- simulateResiduals(mod_nb, n = 1000)
testDispersion(sim_res)
testZeroInflation(sim_res) 

summary(mod_nb)
```

-0.01 \*, complètement drivé par les grandes cultures, voir ci-dessous car ns pour les 2 autres types de culture et -0.02 en vigne

# 3. Whole dataset

## 3.1. Bruches

```{r}
mod <- glmmTMB(Bruches~ year_c  + nbre_interv + CoefN + nbre_pesticides+ (1| id_parcelle), family=nbinom2, data=coleo_agri)
check_collinearity(mod)
sim_res <- simulateResiduals(mod, n = 1000)
plot(sim_res)
testDispersion(sim_res)
testZeroInflation(sim_res) 

summary(mod)
Anova(mod)
r2(mod)
```

## 10.1. Predators

```{r}
mod <- glmmTMB(predat ~  nbre_interv + CoefN + nbre_pesticides+ crop_type + (1 | id_parcelle), family = nbinom2, data = coleo_agri)

plot(sim_res)
testDispersion(sim_res)
testZeroInflation(sim_res)

summary(mod)
Anova(mod)
```

nbre pest 0.07 *vignes -0.66* \*\*

```{r}
mod <- glmmTMB(not_predator ~  nbre_interv + CoefN + nbre_pesticides+ crop_type + (1 | id_parcelle), family = nbinom2, data = coleo_agri)

sim_res <- simulateResiduals(mod, n = 1000)
plot(sim_res)
testDispersion(sim_res)
testZeroInflation(sim_res)

summary(mod)
Anova(mod)
```

ns

```{r}
mod <- glmmTMB(mixed_pred ~  nbre_interv + CoefN + nbre_pesticides+ crop_type + (1 | id_parcelle), family = nbinom2, data = coleo_agri)

sim_res <- simulateResiduals(mod, n = 1000)
plot(sim_res)
testDispersion(sim_res)
testZeroInflation(sim_res)

mod2 <- glmmTMB(mixed_pred ~  nbre_interv + CoefN + nbre_pesticides+ crop_type + (1 | id_parcelle), family = nbinom2, ziformula = ~1, data = coleo_agri)

sim_res_zi <- simulateResiduals(mod2)
testZeroInflation(sim_res_zi)
AIC(mod,mod2) #keep mod

summary(mod)
Anova(mod)
```

nbre pesticides 0.07 \*\*
